views.label: Detection
views.note: The leader stops renewing; the lease expires after leaseDuration (3s).

views.label: Election
views.note: The standby acquires the expired lease on its next retryPeriod tick (1s).

views.label: Parallel reconfigure
views.note: The new leader updates CiliumVTEPConfig and replaces the VPC route concurrently.

segments.label: par: VTEP update + route replace (concurrent) — failover complete in ~5–10s

messages.label: renew lease — fails
messages.note: Node failure / pod crash; lease expires after leaseDuration (3s)

messages.label: acquire lease (retryPeriod 1s)
messages.note: Gateway Pod 2 becomes the new leader

messages.label: ec2:ReplaceRoute
messages.note: VPC routes now point at the new leader's ENI (1–3s)

cards.title: Failover Timeline
items: Detection 0–3s: leader fails to renew; lease expires after leaseDuration
Election 0–1s: standby acquires the lease on the next retryPeriod tick
Route update 1–3s (ec2:ReplaceRoute) and VTEP update 1–5s run in parallel

cards.title: During the Failover Window
items: VPC-to-hybrid traffic drops until VPC routes are updated
Hybrid-to-VPC traffic drops until CiliumVTEPConfig is updated
Intra-hybrid traffic is unaffected (Cilium handles it directly)
